result.topic_en: Calculations on second-order linear differential equations: the adjoint operator obtained by integration by parts, and reduction of $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+pu=0$ to a Riccati equation via $u=e^{\int v\,dx}$, with a further substitution involving an auxiliary function $\varphi$.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = p\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + q\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$\int\left(v\;\; p\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \mu\mu u\right)dx$ \quad $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + pu = 0$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 pv}{\partial x^2} + \mu\mu v\right)u$ \quad $\frac{\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2}}{\varphi} + \chi\varphi$ \quad (76)
$u = e^{\int v\,\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = v$ [?]
$v^2 + \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} + p = 0$ \quad $\frac{\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}}{\varphi} + v'$ \quad $2v'\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2}$
$= \varphi\chi'$
$v \mp \frac{v}{\varphi}$
$\frac{v^2}{\varphi^2} + \frac{\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}}{\varphi} \mp \frac{v\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}}{\varphi^2}$
$v \mp \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x} + v\varphi$ \quad $\mathfrak{J}v + \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x} \mp v$
$\partial\mp$ \quad $v\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x} + v\varphi\right) + \frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2} + v\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\varphi$
$v\; 2\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2}$ \quad $v' = -2\frac{\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}}{\varphi}$ [?] $+ \varphi\chi'$
[-$\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}\right)^2/\varphi^2$-] $+ 2\frac{\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2}}{\varphi} [-+-] v'^2 - \frac{\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2}}{\varphi}$ [?] $\varphi = 0$

[upside down, in ink:] $\rho = \varphi\int_1^0$ [?] ... [illegible]
